title: AttributionX
tagline: Attribution for Advertisers : Facilitate sharing of data in a private way to get attribution calculated.
description:
Problem Statement. 

Company A has millions of user data. 
Company B has millions of user data. 

Story to hook users , use Superbowl?:: 


Web3 company is a smart contract enabled website that facilitates this transaction. 

They want to facilitate sharing of data in a private way to get attribution calculated.
how_its_made:
Used Privy to encrypt end user data. "Blockchain technology can be leveraged to safeguard user privacy, thereby restoring trust between viewers, advertisers, and content creators. I’m certainly not saying that you can simply take a jar full of blockchain and just smear it on everything to fix the problem." -Gavin Douglas, iPowow


Data Definition :
viewers = name + email + address + phone number 
advertising platform = NBCU / Facebook / TV / online
Advertisers : Rocket Mortgate, Burger king 

Number of viewers in DB ~ in millions

Company A ------- Big Data 1 = "Viewer Exposure to Ads" -- Exposure Events
Viewer          |    Advertising platform  | Advertiser   |   view_time
Viewer info  |    NBCU                           |  Burger King |  yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss

Company B ---- Big Data 2 = "Viewer Buy Events" --- Buy Events
Viewer    |   Advertiser   |  Dollar Spend | buy_date_time
Viewer    | Burger King  |   $10                | yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss
